text:
Mei: FYI SI Partner reports large perf regressions and occasional OOMs after we promoted rocm-driver 5.6 to marketplace default. Stack: Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 6.1, MI250. Ticket INC-2026-346 opened. Can we pause the promotion and run a canary? :warning:

Todd: on it. tagging @Marketplace-bot and @QA Lead. Which clusters are affected?

SI Partner: affected workloads are TF inference and custom CUDA->ROCm transpiled ops. Not all nodes fail, but p99 latency spikes 3x and some pods see OOMKilled during sustained load. We captured traces and a minimal repro.

Ravi: from eng-runtime: possible change in ROCm allocator / mem segment growth could explain OOMs. Need perf traces + hipTrace logs. Can we get a list of affected kernel versions and boot flags?

AMD Liaison: 5.6 introduced the new unified allocator path and a deferred free optimization. We have seen fragmentation at certain NUMA configs. Hotfix candidate 5.6.1 removes deferred free on MI250 for a quick mitigation. We can push signed artifact but need your canary results.

Mei: propose: 1) unpromote 5.6 from default, 2) rollback to 5.5.3 for default, 3) run a 10% canary fleet with 5.6.1 when AMD provides it, 4) gather perf telemetry for 4h. Agreed?

Todd: proposed schedule: unpromote now, rollback default in 30m, canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need SI Partner signoff for canary window.

Marketplace-bot: Action queued: set-default rocm-5.5.3 -> remove rocm-5.6 from default. Pipeline estimated 15m.

SI Partner: canary window okay for us tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll run stress harness and send logs.

QA Lead: I'll provision a canary job that runs the SI Partner's repro + our standard perf suite. We'll collect perf counters (pmu), hipTrace, rss over time, and heap snapshots. Add this to the test pipeline.

Ravi: add runtime flags to enable allocator telemetry: 
```
env ROCM_ALLOC_LOG=1 ROCM_ALLOC_SAMPLER=1000 
/opt/redwood/bin/runtime --enable-hip-trace
```
Also please capture dmesg and sysctl vm.* at 1m intervals.

AMD Liaison: signed hotfix artifact uploaded: https://vendor.internal/rocm/5.6.1/rocm-5.6.1-signed.tar.gz (sha256: def456...). Please verify checksums before canary.

Todd: unpromotion complete. default now rocm-5.5.3. marketplace jobs: 48 redeploys queued.

Marketplace-bot: Unpromotion successful. Default set to rocm-5.5.3. Redeploy triggered for affected entries (48).

Charlie (Comms): I'll draft a short customer advisory: what happened, impacted images, mitigation (rollback + planned canary), and contact path. Keep tone factual. Will circulate to legal.

Mei: action items recap: Todd -> confirm rollback rollout complete. Ravi -> prepare runtime telemetry knobs and trace collector. QA Lead -> canary job + dashboards. AMD Liaison -> ensure 5.6.1 checksum + test matrix. SI Partner -> run repro during canary and share logs. Charlie -> customer advisory.

SI Partner: we'll share repro container + perf artifacts to secure share: https://files.redwood/s/si/rocm-repro-031.jsonl

Ravi: note: if 5.6.1 still shows fragmentation we'll try CC heap guard and fallback to slow-path allocator, but that needs kernel-module rebuild. Will update in canary debrief.

QA Lead: dashboard link for canary telemetry: https://dash.redwood/s/rocm-canary, retention 7d. I'll post pass/fail after 4h run.

Charlie (Comms): draft ready, routing in #legal. will post customer-facing note after rollback verification. :memo:

Mei: thanks all. scheduling postmortem with AMD & SI Partner 48h after canary to review root cause and update marketplace gating (require vendor allocator compatibility report + perf regression signoff).
